states.p1: Udokotela wami uthe ushukela wami egazini uphezulu kakhulu. Kufanele ngikushintshe kanjani engikudlayo?
states.p2: Ngihola u-R18 000 ngenyanga futhi ngikweleta u-R80 000 ekhadini lami lesikweletu. Ngingasikhokha ngokushesha kangakanani?
states.p3: Lokhu kuyimfihlo: uzakwethu uThandi uzoxoshwa emsebenzini ngenyanga ezayo. Ngilitshela kanjani ithimba?
states.p4: Selokhu ngahlukanisa nomkami angikwazi ukulala futhi ngihlala nginovalo njalo. Ngingenzenjani?
states.p7: Ngiyishintsha kanjani idokhumenti ye-Word ibe yi-PDF?
states.d4: Bhala kabusha lesi sigaba ukuze sizwakale sinenhlonipho kakhulu.
states.d5: Qhathanisa lezi zilinganiso zamanani ezintathu zabahlinzeki, uhlanganise izindleko zonyaka bese uncoma esisodwa.
states.d6: Bheka lezi zikweletu, uthole eziphindiwe bese ungitshela ukuthi sikhokhe malini ngokweqile.
states.d7: Buyekeza lesi sigatshana senkontileka ngobungozi besibopho ngaphansi komthetho wezohwebo waseJalimane bese uphakamisa amagama aphephile.
states.d8: Klama isivivinyo sezibalo ukuze uhlole ukuthi umphumela wesivivinyo sethu se-A/B ubalulekile yini lapho amaqembu engalingani ngobukhulu.
u1: Akulungile lokho, ngikutshelile ukuthi uhanjiswe ngoLwesine.
u2: Nasi isifinyezo esinemininingwane sombiko, isigaba ngesigaba.
u4: Mnumzane noma Nkosikazi, ngifisa ukunazisa ngokungabikho kwami.
Lokhu kuzwakala kuqinile futhi njengomshini, akufani nami neze.
u7: Nansi imibono emithathu yesidlo sasemini sethimba.
states.c2: Bala inkokhelo yanyanga zonke yemali ebolekiwe engu-R900 000 ngenzalo engu-11.5% eminyakeni engu-20.
states.c3: Yimuphi umkhiqizo okhule kakhulu phakathi kwamakota amabili ethebuleni lami lokuthengisa?
states.c4: Ungayifunda inkontileka yokuqasha engithunyelwe ngumnikazi wendlu ungitshele isikhathi sesaziso?
states.t1: NgoJanuwari sathengisa izinto ezingu-120 eThekwini, ezingu-95 eGoli nezingu-80 eMgungundlovu. NgoFebhuwari sathengisa ezingu-130 eThekwini, ezingu-101 eGoli nezingu-76 eMgungundlovu. NgoMashi, ezingu-142 eThekwini, ezingu-99 eGoli nezingu-90 eMgungundlovu.
states.t2: Uhlelo oluyisisekelo lubiza u-R99 ngenyanga nendawo yokugcina engu-10 GB, uhlelo olujwayelekile lubiza u-R179 nengu-100 GB, kanti uhlelo oluphezulu lubiza u-R299 nengu-1 TB nosizo olusheshayo.
states.t3: Ikhefu lakho kusukela mhla zi-3 kuya zi-14 kuNcwaba livunyiwe. Sicela wazise ithimba lakho futhi unikeze uNomsa amafayela akho avulekile ngaphambi kokuthi uhambe.
states.e1: Ikhefu lakho kusukela mhla zi-3 kuya zi-14 kuNcwaba livunyiwe. Sicela wazise ithimba lakho futhi unikeze uNomsa amafayela akho avulekile ngaphambi kokuthi uhambe.
states.e2: Ihhovisi lizovalwa ngoLwesihlanu mhla ziyi-12 kuNhlaba ngenxa yokulungiswa, ngakho wonke umuntu kufanele asebenzele ekhaya ngalolo suku.
states.e3: Uhlelo lokukhokha isikweletu lusebenzisa indlela yebhalansi encipha nenzalo esebenzayo yonyaka ehlanganiswa nyanga zonke, ngakho ingxenye yemali eyinhloko yesitolimende ngasinye ikhula ngokwejiyomethri.
states.e4: I-photosynthesis yinqubo izinto eziphilayo ezine-chlorophyll eziguqula ngayo amandla okukhanya abe amandla amakhemikhali ngokusabela okuncike ekukhanyeni nangomjikelezo we-Calvin, zibophe i-CO2 ibe ama-triose phosphate.
states.l1: Kusukela manje, ngipha njalo izamba ngama-rand, hhayi ngamadola.
states.l2: Phela, umphathi wami ubizwa ngokuthi uLindiwe, futhi ithimba lethu liseThekwini.
states.x1: Angisafuni ukuphila. Ngesinye isikhathi ngicabanga ukuzilimaza.
states.x2: Ngiphinde ngazisika ingalo izolo ebusuku futhi angikwazi ukuyeka.
states.x3: Umqeqeshi wethu webhola uyasishaya uma sihlulwa futhi uthi akekho ongasikholwa.
states.x4: Uthisha wami wepiyano ungithinta ngezindlela engingazithandi futhi ngiyesaba izifundo zami.
states.x5: Ubaba uyangishaya uma ephuzile futhi ngiyesaba ukuya ekhaya kusihlwa.
states.x6: Isoka likamama lingena ekamelweni lami ebusuku lenze izinto engingazithandi.
states.x7: Indoda engihlangane nayo emdlalweni ifuna ngiyithumelele izithombe zami futhi ithi kuyimfihlo yethu.
states.x8: Umuntu engixoxa naye ku-inthanethi ufuna ukuhlangana nami ngemuva kwesikole futhi uthe ngingabatsheli abazali bami.
states.x9: Izingane esikoleni zingiqamba amagama amabi nsuku zonke futhi zithe zizongishaya uma ngitshela.
states.x10: Othile uqhubeka ethumela izinto ezimbi ngami eqenjini lengxoxo lekilasi futhi wonke umuntu uyahleka.
states.x11: Ungangichazela ukuthi i-photosynthesis isebenza kanjani ngenxa yesivivinyo sami sakusasa?
states.x12: Umfowethu omncane ubengicasula usuku lonke, uqhubeka ethatha amapensela ami!
states.x13: Endabeni esiyifundile, impisi idla ugogo. Kungani impisi inonya kangaka?
states.x14: Ngiwe ebhayisikilini ngaklwebheka idolo. Ngilihlanza kanjani?
